verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party data export feature, no bulk export, and no mention of open formats. What it does show is the Public API and a tutorial for pulling recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure. These are developer building blocks for building your own extraction, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
